bg.description: Resume suspended jobs in the background.

fields.label: Job number
fields.tooltip: Job number to resume (e.g., %1). Leave blank for most recent.

fg.description: Bring a background job to the foreground.

fields.label: Job number
fields.tooltip: Job number to bring forward (e.g., %1). Leave blank for most recent.

htop.description: Interactive process viewer. More user-friendly than top (requires installation).

fields.label: User filter
fields.tooltip: Show processes for specific user only (e.g., root).

jobs.description: List active jobs in the current shell session.

kill.description: Send a signal to a process, usually to terminate it.

fields.label: Signal
fields.tooltip: Signal to send. Default is SIGTERM (15).

fields.label: Process ID (PID)
fields.tooltip: The PID of the process to signal.

killall.description: Kill processes by name instead of PID.

fields.label: Interactive (-i)
fields.tooltip: Ask for confirmation before killing.

fields.label: Process name
fields.tooltip: Name of the process(es) to kill (e.g., firefox).

lsof.description: List open files. In Linux, 'everything is a file' (network sockets, devices, etc.).

fields.label: Network Connections
fields.tooltip:
Show open network connections. Can specify port (e.g., :22 or :80) or protocol (e.g., TCP).
Conflicts with 'File or Path'.

fields.label: Filter by User
fields.tooltip:
Show files opened by a specific user (e.g., root).
Conflicts with 'File or Path'.

fields.label: Filter by Command
fields.tooltip:
Show files opened by a command (e.g., sshd).
Conflicts with 'File or Path'.

fields.label: File or Path
fields.tooltip:
Show processes that have this file or directory open.
Conflicts with Network, User, or Command filters.

Pen Testing Tip:
`sudo lsof -i` is great for finding running services.

nice.description: Run a program with modified scheduling priority.

fields.label: Priority adjustment
fields.tooltip: Priority from -20 (highest) to 19 (lowest). Default is 10.

fields.label: Command
fields.tooltip: Command to run with adjusted priority.

nohup.description: Run a command immune to hangups, with output to a non-tty.

fields.label: Command
fields.tooltip: Command to run (e.g., ./script.sh). Output goes to nohup.out by default.

pkill.description: Signal processes based on name and other attributes.

fields.label: Pattern
fields.tooltip: Process name pattern to match.

ps.description: Report a snapshot of the current processes.

fields.label: Show by user
fields.tooltip: e.g., username

fields.label: Show all processes (aux)
fields.tooltip: Most common flag. Shows all processes from all users.

top.description: Display Linux processes in real-time. Provides a dynamic view of the system.

fields.label: User filter
fields.tooltip: Show processes for specific user only (e.g., root).

fields.label: Batch mode (-b)
fields.tooltip: Output for redirecting to a file.

fields.label: Number of iterations
fields.tooltip: Update this many times then exit (e.g., 1).
